text:
Alex J: Heads-up — proposing a targeted validation next week: driver 532.07 + fw 48.16 + kernel 6.1.52 across a small canary fleet to measure XID/ECC delta. Looking for input on sample size and rollback criteria.
Maria S: Regions? prefer us-west1 and eu-west1 to cover two HW batches and different NIC firmware.
Devin K: +1. Suggest 72h burn-in with synthetic load (60% avg GPU). Sample: 20 GPUs across 10 hosts. Capture pre-upgrade 7d baseline.
Ryan O: Are we doing pure synthetic or a bit of prod traffic? Need to avoid user impact.
Alex J: Synthetic primarily via burn-in harness. Will route 2% low-priority prod traffic after 24h if no red flags.
Kim T: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if per-host XID rate >3x baseline or ECC spikes >2 events in 1h or node reboots >1 in 6h.
Devin K: Prometheus queries to use:
```
sum(rate(gpu_xid_total[1h])) by (host)
sum(rate(gpu_ecc_corrected_total[1h])) by (host)
```
Also capture 95th latency on inference paths and PCI errors.
Maria S: Need alerting thresholds in Console and a dashboard snapshot. I'll add panels and an oncall alert for XID-rate and ECC.
Alex J: Drain plan snippet for canary hosts:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-canary-01
kubectl drain gpu-canary-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
We'll do rolling drains with 30m between hosts.
sre-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (operator: Alex J)
Ryan O: Cost tradeoff — burning 20 GPUs at 72h = ~1,440 GPU-hours. Rough estimate $2.4k at current spot-equivalent. OK to proceed with leadership.
Kim T: Who will own the 03:00 UTC rotation for alerts during the 72h? I can take first 24h.
Devin K: I'll own second 24h, Ryan will take last 24h.
Alex J: Thanks. I'll update the runbook and add a safe-fallback image + kernel flag to force older driver if rollback triggered. Will also snapshot model checkpoints.
sre-bot: canary started: 2026-03-22T02:05:12Z (hosts: gpu-canary-01..10)
Ryan O: Quick note — first 12h metric: node gpu-canary-02 XID rate down 45% vs baseline. No ECC increases.
Alex J: Nice. Keep running. Collect logs and set aside nodes for deeper HW inspection after finish.
Maria S: I'll schedule a 30m post-canary sync 1h after burn-in completes.
Alex J: Thanks everyone — postmortem & decision on rollout to larger pool after results.
